Class GraphSpan

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphSpan
final class GraphSpan extends Object
The span is the gap a fresh layout leaves between nodes. The box covers the glyph and the letters at the seated point size.

  • Method Details

    • step

      static int step(GraphModel model, int points)
      The method returns the widest box in this model. A fresh layout does not use this width as its gap. A point size below 1 is read as 1.
      Parameters:
      model - The model supplies the ids.
      points - The points are the seated font size.
      Returns:
      The return value is that width.

    • box

      static int[] box(String id, boolean intent, int reached, int points)
      The method returns the extents around one center. The order is left, right, up, down.
      Parameters:
      id - The id is the painted name.
      intent - The intent flag selects the intent glyph.
      reached - The reached count widens an intent.
      points - The points are the seated font size.
      Returns:
      The return value is those four extents.

    • gather

      static int gather(GraphModel model, String start)
      The method counts the intents reached from one start.
      Parameters:
      model - The model holds the relations.
      start - The start is one intent id.
      Returns:
      The return value is that count.

    • spiral

      static int[] spiral(int index)
      The method returns the spiral cell for one index. Index 0 is the origin.
      Parameters:
      index - The index is the cell number.
      Returns:
      The return value is the column and the row.

    • wordSeats

      static int[][] wordSeats(int[] intentBox, int[][] wordBoxes)
      The method seats meat words in one row under the intent. The row is centered on the intent. The gap is the facing extents plus the pad.
      Parameters:
      intentBox - The intent box is left, right, up, down.
      wordBoxes - Each word box uses that same order.
      Returns:
      Each row is the horizontal and vertical shift.

    • wordBoxes

      static int[][] wordBoxes(List<String> words, int points)
      The method returns the boxes of the meat words.
      Parameters:
      words - The words are the meat ids.
      points - The points are the seated font size.
      Returns:
      Each row is left, right, up, down.

    • bounds

      static int[] bounds(int[] intentBox, int[][] wordBoxes, int[][] seats)
      The method returns the cluster around one intent center. The order is minimum x, maximum x, minimum y, maximum y.
      Parameters:
      intentBox - The intent box is left, right, up, down.
      wordBoxes - The word boxes use that same order.
      seats - The seats are the word shifts.
      Returns:
      The return value is that cluster.

    • ray

      static int[] ray(int ox, int oy, int dir, int[] bounds, List<int[]> placed)
      The method walks one compass ray until the cluster clears. East, south, west, and north are directions 0 through 3.
      Parameters:
      ox - The ox is the anchor.
      oy - The oy is the anchor.
      dir - The dir selects the ray.
      bounds - The bounds are the cluster being seated.
      placed - Each placed row is the center and its bounds.
      Returns:
      The return value is the clear center.
